entry.summary: A visitor permit is needed for every visit, issued through the Tokelau Apia Liaison Office in Samoa. Reported requirements include a medical check, a police report and approval from the village council.
entry.other: Travel is by boat from Apia, so Samoa's entry rules apply first. Reported processing fee NZ$100 (about A$80 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = NZ$1.2480) and 1 to 2 months' processing.
entry.next_check: Email the Tokelau Apia Liaison Office for the current form, fee and whether travel is open.

layers.authority: The village council (Taupulega) of each atoll, through the Tokelau Apia Liaison Office
layers.process: A visitor permit needs the village's approval. Apply well ahead and say which atoll and why you're visiting.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for Tokelau, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. Visitors need an entry permit, issued only after the village Taupulega (council) approves. Each Taupulega can set its own village rules and fees.
